evidence.title: GenAI Agents: Comprehensive Repository for Development and Implementation

name: GenAI Agents
summary: 57 tutorials and notebook implementations of generative AI agent techniques, from conversational bots to multi-agent systems.
description: Notebook tutorials and implementations organised by category (beginner, framework, educational, business, creative, analysis, news, shopping, task management, QA), built with LangGraph, LangChain, PydanticAI, CrewAI, AutoGen, OpenAI Swarm and LightRAG. Each covers a working agent, from a first conversational bot to multi-agent research systems.
contains: categories: beginner, framework, educational, business, creative, analysis, news, shopping, task management, QA
frameworks: LangGraph, LangChain, PydanticAI, CrewAI, AutoGen, OpenAI Swarm, LightRAG
agent examples: customer support, essay grading, travel planning, recruitment, meme and podcast generation
companion resources: RAG Techniques, Agents Towards Production, Prompt Engineering, Agent Memory Techniques
